summary: 12 countries. The midterm season opening dominates, with mail voting fights in the courts and a strong August jobs report read as a political event abroad. Around that, outlets lead on the Iran conflict and fuel prices, chip and drone tariffs, AI rules at the G20, a Pentagon resignation, a New York stabbing, birthright citizenship, and sport and culture from the US Open to BTS in Los Angeles.
